policy: Fresh Rust outcomes reviewed against the independently implemented Unicode15.0.0 conservative URL profile: pinned lowercase and rejection tables, explicit alternate-dot/fullwidth mapping, RFC3492 roundtrip, and conservative RTL checks. No Kotlin result is an expected Rust outcome. Unknown category changes are failures; see README.md.
